verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents its own REST and GraphQL APIs for managing products, orders, customers and store settings programmatically. It also offers OAuth API accounts with scoped credentials, API clients, and trial/sandbox stores, which together allow UI-free automation of the platform. Its 'headless' marketing mostly refers to decoupled storefronts, and nothing documents CI-specific tooling. One community report of API throttling and dropped connections lowers confidence in unattended automation. missing for 10: documented CI/CD workflow or CLI for pipeline use, headless automation guidance beyond raw API access, independent corroboration of reliable unattended API automation

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote:
Use REST and GraphQL APIs to manage products, orders,
customers, and store settings programmatically.
BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers who wish to use BigCommerce's REST APIs: store-level credentials, app-level credentials, and account-level credentials.

Sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API
calls and build integrations without affecting live data.
go fully headless with the GraphQL Storefront API.
